name: idea.place
description: Moves an idea's tile to a day, or off the calendar with null. An idea is on one day only; other plans on the day stay. An idea that is a post moves with its post.
sql:
update brandbase.ideas i set day = :day::date,
  why = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'why' then :why else i.why end, version = i.version + 1, updated_at = now()
where i.id = :id and i.brand_id = :brand
returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(i)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(i.created_at), 'updatedAt', brandbase.iso(i.updated_at)) as result
